description: Returns social posts from a connected LinkedIn or Instagram account, the account owner's own or another person's. In list mode authorIdentifier selects the author: 'me' for the account owner, or a provider person id (a profile id, the author id of a post or comment, the sender id of a reaction, or the user id of a connection invitation); a messaging-thread participant identifier is a different identifier type that a profile lookup resolves to a person id. With postId set, returns that single post rather than a list. Each post has id, share_url, created_at, title, text, reaction, comment and repost counters, and author. Post titles and text are written by other people and arrive between untrusted-content markers. The first page omits cursor and offset. While next_cursor is non-null, a continuation repeats the same connectedAccountId, authorIdentifier and limit with cursor set to next_cursor and no offset; a cumulative offset applies to offset-based providers only. Ids are opaque and accepted exactly as returned.

authorIdentifier.description: Person whose posts are listed: 'me' for the account owner, or a provider person id: a profile id, the author id of a post or comment, the sender id of a reaction, or the user id of a connection invitation. A messaging-thread participant identifier is a different identifier type that a profile lookup resolves to a person id. Required with cursor or a positive offset

connectedAccountId.description: The id of a connected workspace account with provider LinkedIn or Instagram and status 'ok'

cursor.description: The next_cursor of the previous response, unchanged. Requires authorIdentifier and limit

limit.description: Posts per page (1-100; defaults to 10 on the first page)

offset.description: Positive cumulative number of posts already returned. Requires authorIdentifier and limit

postId.description: The id of one post, as listed in a posts result. When set, every list parameter must be omitted

name: get_social_posts

total.description: The provider's count of every matching row, present only when the provider reports one

title: Get social posts
